clock_contract.units: File-initial1000 integer units per authored second; reciprocal computed by2FA60/4C0C00.65E710 converts its signed integer argument; it does not fetch the clock.65E730 truncates float*unitfactor viaCVTTSS2SI.
clock_contract.quant: 65F440 interpolates slowdown only when pause count is zero, then always adds integer delta4C into32-bit clock48 and emits FD2. The clock addition has no pause gate, scale operation or clamp.
clock_contract.ordinary: 583250 pushes true context, invokes65F440 only when pausecount0 and frameflags&4, then publishes FD3 outside that gate, then pops context. Reviewed scheduling slice, not full network/worker behavior.
clock_contract.explicit: 65F3D0 pushes true, invokes65F440, emitsFD3, pops.65F5E0 pushes true, invokes65F440, pops withoutFD3. Neither checks pause before invoking core.
clock_contract.reset: 65F390 zeroes48 and walks separate global registered list1556E60, assigning payload8=payload10. It does not clear delta, pauses, slowdown requests or actual slowdown. Scene create and destroy call reset.
clock_contract.pause: Opaque token set: duplicate insert/absent remove no-op.0->1 token emits FD7 true;1->0 emitsfalse. Membership returns AL bool. No composition with separate mute event in this contract.

frame_contract.frequency: 657E80 stores QueryPerformanceFrequency/1000 as counts per millisecond.
frame_contract.derived_delta: If override0: seconds=float((QPCdifference*1000)/counts_per_ms)*1e-6. Optional fixed-cadence branch uses.04 or1/configured_frequency. rawms=trunc(seconds*1000); delta=clamp(trunc(float(rawms)/actual_slowdown50),1,100). Integer truncation before dividing by slowdown is observable.
frame_contract.override: Nonzero154C158 bypasses wall-time calculation, slowdown division and clamp; delta setter copies exact integer. Override setter57B3B0 is memory XCHG.
frame_contract.flags: 57B380 loads old flags, computes OR mask or AND~mask, then XCHG writes result and returns replaced value. The load/compute/exchange sequence is not a single atomic read-modify-write OR/AND operation. Raw editor4042A0 agrees.
frame_contract.render_helper: 57B3C0 saves flags, temporarily sets8, emits17/1A/1D/20, restores flags; no direct quant or clock addition. Callback effects outside this local contract.
frame_contract.scope: QPC source and delta formula established; event router dispatch, worker lifecycle and full cadence/pacing still open. Actual slowdown changes in quant after mainframe has already selected the current delta.

slowdown_contract.requests: Append missing token; update existing token in place without reordering. Last row controls. Only a top-row update computes (target-current)/transition_divisor and emitsFEF.
slowdown_contract.interpolation: When unpaused and abs(actual-target)>1e-5: add stored step once per quant. For finite step>+epsilon clamp with min(new,target); otherwise max(new,target). Small positive steps<=epsilon therefore take max branch. On reaching epsilon of target emitFEF.
slowdown_contract.remove: Removing non-top shifts rows but does not recalculate or publish. Removing top recalculates new top and emitsFEF if any remain. Empty stack leaves actual50 unchanged.
slowdown_contract.getter: 65EBA0 returns last requested target or1 for empty stack, not actual50.65EB80 requests token=self,target1,divisor1; does not clear other tokens.
slowdown_contract.guard: Game request add/update returns when global15A4A80!=0; GEM counterpart alwaysfalse. Global producer/policy remains open. Removal has no such guard.
slowdown_contract.serialization: scenequant saves/loads rawinteger48. speed saves target from token=self if present, even when not top; load inserts/updates self request with transition divisor20. Neither entire stack nor actual factor is serialized by these two fields.
slowdown_contract.validation: No local positive, nonzero or finite checks on request target/divisor. Formula claims describe ordinary finite values; exceptional floating point behavior not extrapolated.

timer_codec_contract.duration: 65E750 text float->integer duration;65E780 inverse textfloat;65E7A0/7D0 binaryraw4-byte integer;65E7F0/810 textinteger.65E830 directly creates now+convertedfloat without negative-inactive gate.
timer_codec_contract.relative_deadline: Text/binary relative codecs store0 asfloat-1. Nonzero deadline stores signed32(deadline-now)*reciprocal. Load nonnegativefloat creates now+trunc(value*1000); negative creates0. Object-first and stream-first variants agree; stream-first textsave is raw code in both binaries.
timer_codec_contract.derived_consequence: An expired nonzero deadline can serialize a negative remaining duration that reloads as inactive0. Zero is special and the clock arithmetic is32bit, so this is not a wrap-safe ordering guarantee.

rng_contract.default: 5549F0 obtains eThreadStorage default instance through555380 and its separate TLS index at storage8. Null TLS allocates via callable factory, invokes no-op callback, registers pointer under lock, then sets default TLS. Factory creates38-byte RNG, captured seed andmetadata, counter0, emptyname; default getter supplies zero capture. No hardware entropy in reviewed factory.
rng_contract.selected: 554B50 uses independent TLS index154AF7C. Null selected slot falls back to default and saves that pointer.554CE0 returns previous selected pointer and installs supplied pointer if different; no local retain/release.
rng_contract.context: Packed boolean stack, emptyfalse. Push/pop compare old/newtop; only changedboolean switches selected pointer: true->synced_global plus FP control; false->default. Sameboolean nested context preserves selected custom/entity pointer. This is not a stack restoring arbitrary prior RNG pointers.65F9D0 explicitly applies top but no located codecaller.
rng_contract.synced: 6FBD60 returns inner randomizer at global147F430 (outer147F420), name synced_global, initialstate/counter0,metadata1. Thread-safe static initialization does not imply all draws are protected.
rng_contract.floating_point: True-context transition invokes _controlfp_s with value0x108001F,mask0x308031F. Bit meanings and cross-platform emulation are not inferred here.
rng_contract.correction: Sound asset4CF9F0 calls default getter5549F0, bypassing selected getter554B50. Corrects prior sound-map current-context label. This default stream is shared by other default users and is not proven audio-exclusive. Speaker cycle/recovery does use selected getter.
rng_contract.startup_slice: D0C7A0 seeds synced state from startup field200->214, resets synced counterC, seeds default state with(signedseed>>4)*3, sets delta and override50, clearsflags4. This is one startup path, not universal initial state.
rng_contract.open: Selected pointer scopes across all callbacks, registered default instance cleanup, entity RNG ownership/reseed/replication and counter consumers remain open.
